_recipe.title: Event promo
_recipe.when: Fill seats: workshop, meetup, concert, webinar, sale day or launch party.
beats: Hook: city + date slammed in, then the reason to care.
What: the event name, type and one-line promise.
What's inside: four tiles (speakers, sessions, music, food, networking).
Social proof: last edition's turnout or a headline name.
When + where: date, time and venue on a full-colour background (the screenshot frame).
Price: regular price struck out, early-bird price lands.
CTA: book now + where (link in bio / site) + handle.
copyTips: Date, time, venue, prices, speaker names and past turnout must come from the organiser.
Write the date the way locals read it ("Sat, 12 Oct" / "12 Oct, Saturday") and keep it identical on every beat.
Free event? Replace beat 6 with a title: "Entry *free*" + "Register to get a pass".
Pop + bouncy suits fun, community and food events. Tech meetups / hackathons: --theme neon. Conferences / B2B: --theme corporate.
Online event: put the platform ("Live on Zoom") where the venue goes.
